Lemma
[Pseudo-metric on rays] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0486, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0487 ↗ def:chow-iii-i27-ideal-angle 1. appi:1.27\group Asymptotic cones

For $a,b>0$, \[ \lim _{t\to \infty }\frac{d(\gamma _1(at),\gamma _2(bt))}{t} =\bigl(a^2+b^2-2ab\cos \ddinf (\gamma _1,\gamma _2)\bigr)^{1/2}. \] The function $\ddinf $ is a pseudometric, and the ideal boundary is $\M (\infty )=\Ray _{\M }(p)/\{ \ddinf =0\} $.
